sentences.text: In view of statements made, an award in the sum of Rs.40,000/-(Rupees Forty Thousand only) in favour of the petitioner/claimant and against respondents is passed towards full and final settlement of claim of the claimant/injured (minor) for compensation in respect of injuries suffered by the claimant Ms Mannat (minor) in the accident, which is subject matter of present DAR arising out of FIR No.51/2024 under Sections 279/338 IPC and 3/181 of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988, PS Mandir Marg.
APPORTIONMENT/RELEASE.

3. Ms Pinki, mother of claimant/injured Ms Mannat (minor) has given her statement expressing her intention to settle the matter for a sum of Rs 40,000/- Vide order of the even date, it has come on record the claimant and respondents have amicably settled the matter before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi, for a total sum of Rs 40,000/-(Rs Forty Thousand only/-)
as full and final settlement of the claim for injuries suffered by the claimant/victim (minor) in the accident.

In the present matter, entire amount of compensation awarded, Rs 40,000/- be released to the claimant/injured alongwith simple interest @ 9% from the date of filing of the claim petition/DAR till its actual realization, in the bank account of the claimant opened/to be opened near the place of their residence, as directed vide Order dated 22.11.2024.
The Nodal officer of the bank shall ensure disbursement of the award within 3 weeks of receipt thereof by email or otherwise.
5. A copy of this award be given to the parties free of cost and be sent by email.

Ahlmad is directed to send the copy of the award to Ld. Metropolitan Magistrate concerned and Delhi Legal Services Authority, New Delhi District in view of Judgment titled as Rajesh Tyagi Vs. Jaibir Singh & Ors.
passed in FAO no.842/2003 dated 12.12.2014.
